Jacob, saw ASI launch Emergence 2026 while iMIS led the G2 Summer association management category again.

Momentum like that usually means more in-market associations and nonprofits in play than BD can personally touch before they cool. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for ASI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Jacob, quick follow-up for ASI.

With a new conference and fresh G2 wins driving interest, the question is how many meetings BD needs to book to keep pipeline ahead of target, and most teams find the gap late, then scramble the quarter. More reps alone rarely closes it in time.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings ASI needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add headcount.

Jacob, last bit of proof for ASI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how ASI's reply rate likely compares to other B2B software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?

Jacob, I will stop reaching out here, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to ASI either way.
